stratum: Four null all-in momenta summing to zero; parity-even photon on-shell local jet through Mandelstam degree four; arbitrary matching coefficients, not native dynamics
polarization_convention: q=p.sigma; e=epsilon.sigma/sqrt(2); chiral field strengths normalized to lambda*lambda and tilde_lambda*tilde_lambda on helicity states
coefficient_meaning: Amplitude-normalized photon EFT coefficients, not the earlier Dirac-current g2/g3 or Lagrangian coefficients
